title: Yukari and you talk about her father

cues.text: Outside, away from the house, Yukari stands alone with her back to you. You walk up behind her, hands in your pockets.
Yukari walks over and stops close in front of you.
You step in beside her. Yukari puts her arms around you and holds on, her eyes closed.
Yukari starts, and the two of you break apart. You turn away from each other.
You turn toward the voice. Junpei walks up.
Junpei turns and heads back. Yukari follows him, and you walk after them, then stop.
